tasks.label: Setup dev environment
tasks.detail: Create env files, install pnpm + uv deps, build the toolkit

tasks.label: Dev: agent
tasks.detail: UDIAgent FastAPI server (http://localhost:8007). Includes the duckdb/starrocks drivers so it serves whatever UDI_QUERY_BACKENDS in packages/agent/.env configures (or nothing → browser mode).
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra server --extra duckdb --extra starrocks fastapi dev packages/agent/src/udiagent/server/app.py --port 8007 --reload-dir packages/agent/src --reload-dir packages/grammar-py/src

tasks.label: Dev: chat + agent
tasks.detail: Start the core dev stack (chat SPA + agent server) together

tasks.label: Dev: agent (remote/DuckDB)
tasks.detail: UDIAgent server in server-side data mode — loads packages/agent/duckdb-backends.json so /v1/yac query + metadata serve the seeded packages. Run a Data: seed task first. http://localhost:8007
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra server --extra duckdb fastapi dev packages/agent/src/udiagent/server/app.py --port 8007 --reload-dir packages/agent/src --reload-dir packages/grammar-py/src

tasks.label: Dev: chat + agent (remote/DuckDB)
tasks.detail: Server-side data stack: chat SPA + agent with the DuckDB backend. Run 'Data: Use penguins (remote/DuckDB)' first to seed + point the chat at it.

tasks.label: Data: Start StarRocks
tasks.detail: docker compose up the local StarRocks container (idempotent; ~30-60s to become healthy)

tasks.label: Data: Prune pcx demographics
tasks.detail: Drop demographics rows for patients absent from the patient table (the source export ships a whole registry: 2571 rows for 69 patients). Idempotent. Must run BEFORE generating the datapackage so cardinalities and domains describe the cohort.

tasks.label: Data: Generate pcx datapackage
tasks.detail: Regenerate sample-data/pcx/datapackage.json from the CSVs (stdlib only). For another dataset, run scripts/gen_datapackage.py directly.

tasks.label: Data: Seed StarRocks (pcx)
tasks.detail: Load sample-data/pcx into StarRocks and write packages/agent/starrocks-backends.json (waits for the container to be ready)
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra starrocks python packages/agent/scripts/seed_starrocks.py sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Regenerate + seed pcx
tasks.detail: Start StarRocks, regenerate the pcx datapackage, then seed the database — one-click refresh after editing sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Seed DuckDB (pcx)
tasks.detail: Seed sample-data/pcx into a local packages/agent/pcx.duckdb file + write duckdb-backends.json — no container needed. Stop the agent before re-seeding.
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra duckdb python packages/agent/scripts/seed_duckdb.py sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Regenerate + seed pcx (DuckDB)
tasks.detail: Regenerate the pcx datapackage, then seed a local DuckDB file — zero-infrastructure alternative to StarRocks (no Docker)

tasks.label: Data: Use penguins (remote/DuckDB)
tasks.detail: One-click server-side (remote) setup with the bundled penguins package: seed it into a local packages/agent/penguins.duckdb (+ duckdb-backends.json) and point the chat at it (VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE=penguins). Then run 'Dev: chat + agent (remote/DuckDB)'. Stop the agent before re-seeding. NOTE: writes packages/chat/.env.local, which takes precedence over .env — if you keep your settings in .env, they stop taking effect until you edit or delete .env.local.
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra duckdb python packages/agent/scripts/seed_duckdb.py sample-data/penguins && node scripts/set-chat-data-source.mjs penguins --remote

tasks.label: Data: Use HuBMAP (CSV, browser mode)
tasks.detail: Reset the chat to the bundled HuBMAP CSV dumps in interactive (browser) mode — points VITE_UDI_DATA_PACKAGE at /data/hubmap and disables VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE in packages/chat/.env.local. Restart the chat dev server after. (The underlying script takes a package arg, e.g. `pcx`, for other bundled sources.) NOTE: .env.local takes precedence over .env — settings kept in .env stop taking effect once this file exists.
